bundle.shortDescription: Convert documents to Markdown and build local knowledge indexes
bundle.longDescription: CPAH Docs watches folders on Windows and macOS, converts Office documents and PDFs locally, uses MinerU for OCR, and optionally classifies Markdown with compatible language or decision models. Available in English and Simplified Chinese.
